##### Project general facts

Yas Golf Collection by Aldar is a contemporary residential development, which offers a selection of furnished studios and one-bedroom apartments, as well as unfurnished two- and three-bedroom residences. The development is designed to provide residents with access to a vibrant island lifestyle, with opportunities to practice golf at Yas Links, relax by the beach, explore Yas Mall, and enjoy the entertainment and attractions of Yas Theme Parks.

The development combines elegant architecture with sophisticated shared spaces, creating a refined residential environment. The interiors feature an opulent lobby enhanced by contemporary art, as well as sophisticated lounges designed to provide residents with comfortable spaces for relaxation and socializing. Every element of the development has been carefully considered to reflect a sense of elegance and contemporary living.

Yas Golf Collection has been designed and constructed to meet a 2 Pearl Rating under Estidama, Abu Dhabi’s sustainable building rating system. The architecture incorporates ethically sourced natural materials, reflecting an approach focused on environmental responsibility. Furnished apartments include equipped kitchens, while the residences are available in both furnished and unfurnished configurations, depending on the unit type.

##### Location description and benefits

Yas Island is a prominent leisure and entertainment destination in Abu Dhabi, offering a wide range of attractions, recreational facilities, hospitality venues, and lifestyle experiences. The island is home to Yas Marina Circuit, which hosts the Formula 1 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix, as well as numerous destinations that attract visitors and residents throughout the year.

The island offers a diverse selection of entertainment and leisure attractions, including Ferrari World Abu Dhabi and Yas Waterworld. Ferrari World features a range of attractions and rides inspired by the Ferrari brand, while Yas Waterworld offers water slides, rides, and pools for visitors of different ages. Together with Yas Theme Parks and Yas Mall, these destinations provide residents with a wide variety of activities within close reach.

Beyond its major attractions, Yas Island features luxury hotels and resorts, restaurants, bars, and entertainment venues catering to different preferences. Its convenient connectivity and proximity to Abu Dhabi International Airport make the island easily accessible for both local residents and international visitors, while its combination of leisure, hospitality, retail, and entertainment supports a vibrant modern lifestyle.
